newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CKD Holding posts 1996 loss.
newsitem.headline: Czech CKD Holding posts 1996 loss.

text.p: The Czech engineering group CKD Holding a.s. said on Tuesday it had a consolidated net loss for 1996 of 924.7 million crowns, after an 87 million crown net profit in 1995.
CKD general director Jiri Marousek told a news conference that the loss was due in part to the creation of reserves totalling 2.7 billion crowns.

"That, along with two billion crown accounting loss connected to long-term obligations of the Russian Federation to CKD, in the year 1996 our firm conducted a needed cleaning of its balance sheet," Marousek said.
Total 1996 production turnover however fell 8.322 billion crowns from 10.122 billion in the previous year, the company said.
"In 1997 we plan high growth in our pre-tax profit," Marousek added, but provided no specific forecast for the year.
